activity_summary: Before church you spoke the crack again and left it where Friday left it. Phillips said on Saturday that the mornings have not begun. You will not cut her, and you will not see Nick today. You turned from that to the letter.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Named for Saturday's word, and not in the room.

facets.activity: Spoke the crack again before church

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not cut her. I will not write her a line lower.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Phillips said the mornings have not begun.
